 Bologna vs Monza Prediction, 11/1/2026 Soccer Pick, Tips and Odds
 by Josh Schonwald - 10/27/2026 
 Game: Bologna vs Monza
 Date: Sunday, November 1, 2026
 Location: Renato Dall'Ara in Bologna, Italy
 TV: Paramount+, DAZN
 Bologna (2-2-4) hosts Monza (2-1-5) at Renato Dall'Ara in Bologna, Italy on Sunday. Bologna are priced at -182 while the White and Reds are at +150. The betting total comes in at 3. The goalies protecting the net are Lukasz Skorupski for Bologna and Noel Tornqvist for Monza.
 Bologna has amassed 22 saves and they also hold a save rate of 68.8% for the season. The team's differential on goals is currently at -2 as a result of 8 goals scored and also 10 goals given up. The Greyhounds rank 13th for goals expected with 19.6, and the xGA are coming in at 22.6. Bologna has a total of 15 yellow card warnings over the course of the season. The Greyhounds have conceded 10 goals while giving up 1.25 goals per 90 minutes, and opposing clubs have accumulated 32 shots on target on them. They have accumulated 1 clean sheet, which gives them a % of 12.5% this year. For the year, the team has put together an average of 1.00 pts per contest (8 points) and rank 18th in European soccer with 5 assists.
